segments.speaker: pilot
segments.text: Is it getting chilly in here? I'll nudge the heat up a bit.

segments.speaker: commander
segments.text: {callsign:pilot}, hands OFF that console! That is the flight interface!

segments.speaker: scout
segments.text: [inaudible barking] WAIT. Why is the engine glowing RED?!

segments.speaker: quartermaster
segments.text: Well. That was Mars. Wake me when we get somewhere interesting.

segments.speaker: scout
segments.text: We are LIVE from low orbit! Say hi to chat! Hi chat! HI!

segments.speaker: quartermaster
segments.text: The sponsor would like me to say the snacks are 'fuel for exploration.' They are salty paste.

segments.speaker: commander
segments.text: Stay on script, crew. We represent the whole programme up here!

segments.speaker: pilot
segments.text: Quick check, everyone: nobody touch anything. Everything is fine. I am only looking.
